bind_port.label: Receiver: UDP Port
bind_port.description: The UDP port the VBAN receiver will listen on for connections. Make sure that this server can be reached on the given IP and UDP port by remote VBAN senders.

vban_stream_name.label: Sender: VBAN Stream Name
vban_stream_name.description:
Max 16 ASCII chars.
The VBAN stream name to expect from the remote VBAN sender.
This MUST match what the remote VBAN sender has set for the session name otherwise audio streaming will not work.

sender_host.label: Sender: VBAN Sender hostname/IP address
sender_host.description: The hostname/IP Address of the remote VBAN SENDER.

audio_format.label: PCM audio format
audio_format.description: The VBAN PCM audio format to expect from the remote VBAN sender. This MUST match what the remote VBAN sender has set otherwise audio streaming will not work.

sample_rate.label: PCM sample rate
sample_rate.description: The VBAN PCM sample rate to expect from the remote VBAN sender. This MUST match what the remote VBAN sender has set otherwise audio streaming will not work.

bind_ip.label: Receiver: Bind to IP/interface
bind_ip.description:
Start the VBAN receiver on this specific interface. 
Use 0.0.0.0 to bind to all interfaces, which is the default. 
This is an advanced setting that should normally not be adjusted in regular setups.

vban_queue_strategy.label: Receiver: VBAN queue strategy
vban_queue_strategy.description: What should happen if the receiving queue fills up?

vban_queue_size.label: Receiver: VBAN packets queue size
vban_queue_size.description: This can be increased if MA is running on a very low power device, otherwise this should not need to be changed.

log_vban_stream_stats.label: Log VBAN stream statistics
log_vban_stream_stats.description: Log VBAN stream statistics when DEBUG/VERBOSE logging is enabled. Target numbers not being hit will result in audio glitches/dropouts and is indicative of a low power device unable to keep up with the incoming stream rate.

user.title: Configure VBAN Receiver
user.description: Enter the remote VBAN sender details, stream format and local receiver endpoint.

manifest.description: VBAN protocol receiver - receive PCM-over-UDP streams from a VBAN protocol sender

errors.no_packets: VBAN sender {0} did not send any packets on stream {1}.
